Consider the arc of the curve y=5x−x3 that lies in the first quadrant between its x-intercepts. What integral gives the area of the surface generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
2π∫0526−30x2+9x4dx
b
2π∫05x26−30x2+9x4dx
c
2π∫05x12−5x2+3x4dx
d
2π∫054−3x2dx
e
2π∫05x4−3x2dx
